title: FIFA World Cup Final Halftime Show 2026: How to Watch Justin Bieber, Madonna, Shakira, BTS & Others Live Online Free
summary: Here's everything you need to know about FIFA's big day of soccer and live music performances.

For the first time in the international tournament’s 96-year history, the World Cup Final includes an American-style halftime show with music performances from top recording artists in-between the two halves of Spain vs. Argentina.

The FIFA World Cup Final Halftime Show takes place on Sunday (July 19) at MetLife Stadium in East Rutherford, New Jersey.

Watch 2026 FIFA World Cup Final Halftime Show with DirectV

How to Watch 2026 FIFA World Cup Final Halftime Show Online, At a Glance:

- Date: July 19

- Broadcast Channels: FOX

- Streaming: DirecTV , Fubo , Hulu + Live TV , Sling TV , FOX One

When Does 2026 FIFA World Cup Final Halftime Show Start ?

The FIFA World Cup Final Halftime Show airs on FOX on Sunday (July 19) and starts after the first half of the match (along with any stoppage time). The show is expected to start around 4 p.m. ET/1 p.m. PT.

In addition, the World Cup Halftime Show has a Spanish-language broadcast on Telemundo.

Who Is Performing During 2026 FIFA World Cup Final Halftime Show?

Curated by Chris Martin from Coldplay and produced by the FIFA Global Citizen Education Fund, the World Cup Final Halftime Show features performances from Madonna, Shakira & Burna Boy , Justin Bieber and BTS — including RM, Jin, SUGA, j-hope, Jimin, V and Jungkook. The Los Angeles Philharmonic under conductor Gustavo Dudamel is also set to perform.

Meanwhile, the international soccer event has a closing ceremony , which is scheduled to take place before the final match. It has a start time of 1:30 p.m. ET/11:30 a.m. PT. The ceremony has performances from the likes of Nicole Scherzinger, Laura Pausini and Robbie Williams. Influencer IShowSpeed and actor Tom Cruise are expected to make special appearances.

And before the match begins, Jennifer Hudson performs “The Star-Spangled Banner,” the U.S. national anthem.
